Sam: FYI spotted an authz mismatch in staging post-key-rotation, looks like per-route scopes are being bypassed when kv-cache hits. :rotating_light:
Sam: Repro steps: rotate key via kms-rewrap, then call /v1/embeddings with the old token metadata - it returns 200 with embedding result even though token only has chat:generate scope.
Sam: Minimal curl I used:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer OLD_TOKEN" -X POST https://staging.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{"input":"test"}'
```
Sam: Auth proxy logs show `authz=ALLOW` with reason `cache-hit` and no per-route-scope-check in the decision.
Priya: Ugh. Could be the authz cache key dropping route metadata or the token tag lost during rewrap. We saw kms metadata drop bugs before.
Jon: Can you paste the auth proxy log line (raw) and the kv-cache key?
Sam: Raw log: `ts=1719234567 service=auth-proxy req_id=abc123 token_tag=oldkey:tag authz=ALLOW reason=cache-hit rules_checked=0 route=/v1/embeddings`
Sam: KV key was `authz:token:OLD_TOKEN:allowlist` — notice it doesn't include `route` in the key.
Marta: That explains it. When cache is keyed only by token, we allow token-wide decisions to be reused across routes. Needs route included.
Priya: Immediate mitigation: rollback cache TTL to 0 in auth-proxy config (hotfix) so we force canonical scope checks until we patch. Also revoke OLD_TOKENs issued within the rotation window.
Priya: Longer term: change cache key to include route and method, and add a KMS metadata verification step post-rewrap to ensure scope tags persist (add signature check).
Jon: I'll draft a PR to include `route` and `http_method` in cache key and add unit tests. Will also add a GA/integration test that exercises embeddings vs chat route when rewrap happens.
eng-sre-oncall: Revoke plan: run `scripts/revoke-rotation-window.sh 2026-04-24T15:00Z` to revoke tokens from the last rotation job, alerting product owners. Need approval from security leads.
Sam: I've uploaded a quick snapshot of affected tokens to the incident board (link: https://internal/redwood/incidents/1719234567).
Marta: Also add an audit field `authz_evidence` to each decision log so we can trace whether the decision was cache-derived or re-evaluated.
Priya: Agreed. Add a regression check to CI that simulates kms rewrap and ensures per-route enforcement.
Jon: I'll pick this up, ETA EOD today for the cache-key change, then a canary deploy to staging.
Priya: Postmortem action items: 1) patch auth-proxy cache key (Jon) 2) revoke tokens and run backfill (eng-sre) 3) KMS metadata verification (Priya) 4) audit log field + alerts (Marta).
Marta: Assigning owners in the incident doc.
infra-bot: Deploy queued: auth-proxy v2.3.4-hotfix -> staging. CI: 12/14 checks passed.
eng-sre-oncall: I'll coordinate the revocation and monitor for user impact. Ping me if you see production noise.
Sam: Thanks. Short-term priority: block further rotations until we validate metadata fidelity. :white_check_mark:
